title: Choose the visual world for the 1POS admin
question: The roll assigned Route Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Route Board
options.lineage: Jeepney and bus route signboards (Philippine street signage)
options.thesis: Every screen tells you exactly where a change applies, the way a route board tells you where the jeep goes.
materials: condensed signage caps (Barlow Condensed) over Barlow text
options.viewport: Navy left rail with sections; a yellow route plate under the header reads ALPHA TRADING CORP › MAKATI MAIN › ALL REGISTERS and is the scope picker; setup checklist and branch cards below.
options.risk: Yellow plate can read as decoration if it ever appears where it does not set scope; condensed caps tire at body sizes.

raised.raise: Signboard yellow is reserved for one meaning only: where this applies (scope). Never a button, never a highlight.
Plan limits drawn as exact-length segmented bars: 3 of 5 seats is five cells, three filled.
Branch and register cards share one fixed scale and baseline so branches compare at a glance.
Team members render as uniform cells with fixed fields: name, role plate, scope plate, status.
A strict five-step type scale; display caps appear only on plates and page titles.

options.label: Salapi (Peso Notes)
options.thesis: The admin as currency: denomination colours mark what kind of thing you are looking at, serial figures mark exactly which one.
options.viewport: Light note-paper ground, a blue header band, KPI tiles framed in hairline guilloche, IDs and money in serial tabular figures.
options.risk: Money-centric and on-topic, so it is the most familiar move for a POS; guilloche can slide into ornament.

options.label: Coupon Book
options.thesis: Setup as a coupon book: each leg (entity, branch, register) tears off when done; nothing disappears, it is stamped VOID.
options.viewport: Onboarding as a row of coupons, the current leg open; archived records carry a red VOID stamp instead of vanishing.
options.case: Holds product clarity (archive-not-delete states read instantly) but owners do not identify with airline ephemera.
options.risk: Reads retro-costume on dense tables; stamps must stay rare.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Overlapping translucent sheets on an eleven-step zone ramp.
options.viewport: Stacked sheets slide aside instead of replacing the field.
options.risk: Foreign to shop owners; hatching hides money figures.
options.case: Loses both axes for PH shop owners.
options.kept: One colour reserved for exactly one meaning.

options.label: Dance Score
options.thesis: Length of a block is its exact duration.
options.kept: Quantity drawn as exact geometry (limit bars).

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Fixed scale and ground make stages comparable.
options.risk: Cream-and-serif default for a working tool.
options.kept: Identical scale for comparable things (branch cards).

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: A finite roster, each cell with fixed personal furniture.
options.kept: Uniform cells with fixed fields (team roster).

options.label: Bitmap Specimen
options.thesis: One form repeated at strict size steps.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Shopify/Square-style admin executed at full craft: white, neutral sidebar, one blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: Gray sidebar, page title, setup checklist card, stats row.
